reuse.why: Builds on the tree's existing isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection, toBudgetedAverage and setMonthAverage, reads group notes from the existing notes table and parses tags with the shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: All eligibility rules live in isMonthFillCategory; only the has_template/cat_group columns are added to both the getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories queries.

placement.why: The selection rules stay in the month-fill helpers in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps plus tests and a release note; it also folds the old 'all' scope into 'copyable', which slightly changes the helper's vocabulary.

maintainability.why: One readable rule function covers every month-wide action, though copyPreviousMonth has to fetch fixedGroupIds itself and pass it in, leaking a detail of the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (setZero, copyPreviousMonth, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg via setMonthAverage) goes through isMonthFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The only repetition is the has_template/cat_group columns selected in both getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories, which is plainly visible.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory gained fixedGroupIds and includeHiddenCategories (threaded through getMonthFillCategories and setMonthAverage); copyPreviousMonth computes fixedGroupIds itself because it selects through getBudgetData, but no call site bypasses the helper.
